cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Info > Protect Workbook > Encrypt with Password
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dat mat khau mo file. Quen mat khau khong mo duoc. Nhap sai bao loi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Dat 123 > xac nhan 123 > Save > mo lai doi password

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Review > Protect Sheet > nhap password > OK > xac nhan
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Khoa sheet khong cho sua. Bo khoa: Review > Unprotect Sheet + nhap dung password.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Protect sheet Tong hop 123; click sua bi chan; Unprotect nhap 123 moi sua duoc

cong_thuc.ten: Bao ve vung trong sheet (Unlock all -> Lock vung)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon all > Format Cells > Protection > bo Locked; boi den vung can khoa > tich Locked; Review > Protect Sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh moi o deu Locked nhung chi co tac dung khi Protect Sheet. Nen mo het roi chi Locked vung quan trong (Don vi/Don gia/Thanh tien).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+A bo Locked > chon C:E tich Locked > Protect Sheet pass GX; sua So luong duoc, sua Don gia bi chan; Thanh tien = So luong*Don gia, SUM tong

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+G > Special > Formulas > OK; Format Cells > Protection > Locked + Hidden; Review > Protect Sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Formulas chon het o chua cong thuc; Hidden giup khong hien cong thuc tren Formula Bar khi Protect.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon formulas > Locked+Hidden > Protect 456/123; click o tong khong sua duoc va khong thay cong thuc

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Kiem soat So von la so >=0
cac_buoc: Boi den vung So von
Data > Data Validation > Allow: Whole number
Data: greater than or equal to, Minimum 0
OK; thu nhap -1/text bao loi, nhap 1 OK

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Xay dung cong thuc ma G123 (text+3 so, dai 4)
cac_buoc: DK1: NOT(ISNUMBER(VALUE(LEFT(o,1)))) de check dau la text
DK2: ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(o,3))) de check 3 sau la so
DK3: LEN(o)=4
Gop: =AND(DK1,DK2,DK3); copy (bo dau ' de hien cong thuc) vao Validation Custom

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Bao ve file bang mat khau
cac_buoc: File > Info > Protect Workbook > Encrypt with Password
Nhap password (vd 123, nen dat kho) > OK
Xac nhan lai > OK > Save
Dong mo lai: bat nhap password; sai bao loi
Review > Protect Sheet
Nhap password > OK > xac nhan
Thu sua: bi chan
Bo bao ve: Review > Unprotect Sheet + password

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Bao ve vung Don vi/Don gia/Thanh tien
cac_buoc: Chon toan sheet > Format Cells > Protection > bo Locked > OK
Boi den vung can bao ve (giu Ctrl chon nhieu) > Format Cells > tich Locked
Review > Protect Sheet + password
Kiem tra: sua So luong duoc + cong thuc tu cap nhat; sua vung khoa bi chan

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Khoa toan bo o chua cong thuc + an cong thuc
cac_buoc: Ctrl+A > Format Cells > bo Locked (mo het)
Ctrl+G > Special > Formulas > OK (chon het o cong thuc)

Review > Protect Sheet; kiem tra: o thuong sua duoc, o cong thuc bi chan va khong hien tren Formula Bar
